additional_approval.decision: No additional approval for the explicitly authorized issue tracking, Project board sync, isolated implementation, push, or Ready-for-review PR. Production changes, merging, destructive operations, and backend authorization changes are excluded.

Run UI and browser integration verification in the project Dev Container; keep E2E state isolated and restored.
Keep the Blazor rollback route available and record native OBS smoke as a manual limitation.
